jcr:root.jcr:title: ACPL Framework 0.2.0
jcr:root.jcr:description: Major: vendor library switched from Bootstrap to Bulma — clean slate, no visual overrides. Bulma 1.0.4 is the look; the framework carries only a neutral layout shim (so authored variations keep resolving) and positional scaffolding for ACPL's custom components. Later 0.2.x patches build the visual identity progressively.
